novelty_flags.label: thm:regular-recovery-frontier and related_work
novelty_flags.one_line: The prose frames the result as sharpening ZhouTchetgenTchetgen2024Hidden's fixed-separation regular inference, but no statement names that estimator/result and proves a strict comparator-facing frontier or equivalence.

soundness_flags.label: def:regularity-slack; thm:regular-recovery-frontier
soundness_flags.one_line: The displayed definition invokes undefined signed-slack functions and an unspecified set of model faces, so s_n is not a defined functional.

soundness_flags.label: thm:regular-recovery-frontier
soundness_flags.one_line: Under ass:known-effect-radius and the OEQ lift regime sqrt(n) r_n→rho<∞, sqrt(n) min_j|delta_j|≤sqrt(n)r_n cannot diverge; moreover the radius-face slack is itself O(r_n), so the advertised strong-regime side is outside the maintained local class.

soundness_flags.label: ass:gaussian-outcome; ass:surrogate-ordering; ass:proxy-separation
soundness_flags.one_line: These are stronger parametric/uniform-margin restrictions than their cited sources establish: EHS treats a scalar bounded normal location problem, while Zhou--Tchetgen Tchetgen impose strict relevance/order conditions rather than a shared externally fixed epsilon margin.

soundness_flags.label: ass:known-effect-radius
soundness_flags.one_line: A known scientific upper bound shrinking at the sample-size-dependent root-n rate is not justified for the stated ADNI consumer; the equivalence-study sentence does not establish this load-bearing restriction in that setting.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The cited result is the scalar bounded normal mean X~N(theta,1), theta∈[-tau,tau], with the truncated-Pratt optimum when tau≤2 z_(1-alpha); it does not state a finite-stratum latent Gaussian mixture with common latent-cell variance.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 3, Assumptions 2-4, especially equations/text at lines 159-164 and 181-203
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper assumes strict relevance of Y, A, and Z to the hidden treatment, mutual conditional independence, and a strict surrogate-better-than-random condition; it does not state the proposal's common known epsilon lower bounds on both surrogate and proxy separations.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Split the local known-radius experiment from a strong-identification model without ass:known-effect-radius; define every face slack explicitly, then state the regular-recovery iff only on the latter class.

Retag the Gaussian/common-variance and uniform proxy-margin restrictions as novel restrictions and either provide an ADNI-specific scientific justification or derive a slower frontier under the strict, non-uniform conditions in Zhou--Tchetgen Tchetgen.
Make the Zhou comparator formal: name its estimator and fixed-margin regime, and prove a strict iff comparison showing exactly when its centered interval and the proposed rule agree or diverge.
